reconciled_facts: Create Production is now earned Product behavior.
Creation does not implicitly open, navigate, replace a current Production or change ProductSpace.
Duplicate ProductionName values are allowed and stable ProductionId is the authority that disambiguates them.
Current ProductionSummary exposes only ProductionId + ProductionName.
Current native Productions list renders only ProductionName and assigns that same name as the ListItem accessibility name.
FIRSTUSE remains evidence-pending-adoption and Home A/B remains unresolved.

safe_without_firstuse_or_home: Creation belongs first in the durable Productions/library route, not Home.
A contextual New Production action and creation form can be designed without adopting FIRSTUSE.
Successful creation must return to the Productions context and must not auto-open.
FIRSTUSE may later invoke the same earned creation flow if separately adopted.
design_findings.blocker: Because duplicate names are Product-valid while the current creator-facing summary exposes only the name, two distinct Productions can be visually and programmatically indistinguishable in the library. Shipping creation UI without a stable creator-facing disambiguation rule would make an earned Product identity unreachable in ordinary creator interaction.

options.title: Preserve duplicate names; add a stable presentation-only identity fingerprint
options.contract: When two or more visible ProductionName values are exact duplicates, render a deterministic short fingerprint derived only from exact ProductionId code units; expand the fingerprint length until unique within the current list. The fingerprint is presentation metadata, not a filesystem locator, Product name, sort authority or editable field.
options.impact: Preserves the approved A/A/A Product contract; requires a bounded deterministic presentation algorithm and accessibility copy.

options.title: Revise D3 to exact-name uniqueness
options.contract: Reject creation when another Production has the exact same ProductionName code units. Stored text remains untrimmed/un-normalized; only exact ordinal equality is prohibited.
options.impact: Simpler UI, but reopens the Director-approved duplicate-name Product decision and adds a new catalog constraint.

options.title: Allow visually identical duplicates without disambiguation
options.impact: Not recommended: creator selection and accessibility can no longer reliably communicate which stable Production identity is being acted on.

recommendation: A — preserve the already-approved duplicate-name Product contract and add a stable, conditional presentation fingerprint only when exact duplicate names are present.
nonauthority: No creation UI is implemented by this audit.
No Home A/B alternative is selected.
No rename/delete/import/restore or richer Product ontology is created.
next: Director chooses A or B. C is preserved only as a falsified baseline. After that Q-DESIGN-22 can freeze the bounded creation presentation contract and Q-PROD-05 may implement it.
